verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local inference engine, so controlling context memory allocation across concurrent model instances is a fair axis. The evidence covers SSD expert offload, which bounds weight memory, and one read-only base serving multiple adapter sets. Neither is a documented control for allocating context or KV memory across concurrent instances, so both are only adjacent features.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
